_readme: Shared leader trait catalog. Each trait has one or more modifiers of shape { stat, amount, situation, always, diceType }. always:true means the modifier applies unconditionally; always:false means it only applies in the narrative situation described (GM/player judgment call). A modifier binds to EITHER stat (one of Might/Treasure/Influence/Territory/Sovereignty/all, matched against whichever qualities the selected action rolls) OR action (an exact action name from index.html's action list, e.g. "Controllo dell'Ordine" -- matched only against that one specific action, not by rolled quality) -- never both; most modifiers use stat, action is for the rare case where a bonus is narrowly tied to one specific roll rather than a quality used by several. diceType is optional (Normal Dice/Expert Dice/Master Dice, defaults to Normal Dice when omitted) -- it's only consumed by index.html's action-roll calculator for La Mano (via parser.js's fetchBonuses aggregation); every other family's traits just show amount/stat-or-action/situation as tooltip flavor text on the map and diceType is irrelevant there. Referenced by id from all_info/leaders.json.

traits.label: Iron Fist
traits.description: Rules through fear and the certainty of the sword.

traits.label: Shrewd Trader
traits.description: Never leaves a deal without the better half of it.

traits.description: Has spent a lifetime among spelljammers and knows how to use them.

traits.description: Words come easier than steel, and cut just as deep.

modifiers.situation: Quando tiri per il Controllo dell'Ordine (Might + Sovereignty) -- usarlo riduce permanentemente il Treasure di 1.
